explicitly:Example: CodeFromString¶frommanimimport*classCodeFromString(Scene):defconstruct(self):code='''from manim import Scene, Squareclass FadeInSquare(Scene):def construct(self):s = Square()self.play(FadeIn(s))self.play(s.animate.scale(2))self.wait()'''rendered_code=Code(code_string=code,language="python",background="window",background_config={"stroke_color":"maroon"},)self.add(rendered_code)class CodeFromString(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        code = '''from manim import Scene, Square

class FadeInSquare(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        s = Square()
        self.play(FadeIn(s))
        self.play(s.animate.scale(2))
        self.wait()'''

        rendered_code = Code(
            code_string=code,
            language="python",
            background="window",
            background_config={"stroke_color": "maroon"},
        )
        self.add(rendered_code)Parameters:code_file(StrPath|None) – The path to the code file to display.code_string(str|None) – Alternatively, the code string to display.language(str|None) – The programming language of the code. If not specified, it will be
